title: Bifactor Statistical Indices — bifactor_indices
text: model must bifactor structure one general factor loading items plus orthogonal specific factors. Standardized loadings used. general loadings \(g_i\), specific loadings \(s_i\) errors \(e_i = 1 - g_i^2 - s_i^2\): ECV = \(\sum g_i^2 / \sum (g_i^2 + s_i^2)\). omega_H = \((\sum g_i)^2 / Var_{total}\), omega         adds grouped specific variance numerator. omega_HS (per specific factor) = \((\sum s_i)^2 / Var_{sub}\). H = \(1/(1 + 1/\sum (\lambda_i^2/(1-\lambda_i^2)))\). PUC = proportion item correlations items         different specific factors. IECV_i = \(g_i^2 / (g_i^2 + s_i^2)\) (item purity toward G).

title: Split-Half Cross-Validation of a Factor Model — cross_validate_cfa
text: Assesses --sample stability one-factor scale repeated split-half cross-validation. sample randomly split many times; split one-factor model fitted fit reliability recorded independent subsamples. Two modes available: () confirm fixed item set (default), (b) test procedure re-deriving short form redundancy_short_form calibration half confirming validation half (set derive_k). Mode (b) also returns often item selected, exposing whether data-driven short form capitalizes chance.

title: EFA-Boosting Optimization — efa_boosting
text: Performs iterative, machine-learning-inspired optimization Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA). algorithm integrates: (1) greedy item--item elimination, (2) optional global subset search (multi-item removal), (3) structural rule enforcement (loadings, Heywood / near-Heywood, cross-loadings, minimum items per factor), (4) adaptive minimum interfactor correlation checks, (5) composite fit index whose weights adapt dynamically degrees freedom sample size (df x N), following Kenny McCoach (2003) Shi, Lee Maydeu-Olivares (2019). function handles ordinal data (WLSMV) includes robust corrections, adaptive weighting rules, optional GPT-based conceptual analysis removed (optionally retained) items. verbose = TRUE, function prints complete EFA-Boosting Optimization Summary Report including: () iteration diagnostics (RMSEA, SRMR, CFI, df, composite loss), (b) identification elimination structural problems, (c) global-search progress bars decisions, (d) thresholded final structure, (e) interfactor-correlation compliance check, (f) AI-based conceptual interpretations. Returns complete list results invisibly.

title: Exploratory Factor Analysis Optimizer with Optional LLM Support — efa_optimizer
text: Automatically refines Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) solution combining global fit (scaled RMSEA), item-level loading quality, explicit detection Heywood/near-Heywood cases. iteration routine re-fits model, removes worst offending item (structural fault RMSEA improvement), stops predefined fit/structure criteria met admissible improvement remains. title: Exploratory Factor Analysis Optimizer with Optional LLM Support — efa_optimizer
text: Iteration logic. Fit EFA using package's internal EFA engine current item set (oblique rotation default). Extract loading matrix \(L\) factor correlation matrix \(\Phi\) (identity unavailable). Derive communalities \(h^2 = \mathrm{diag}(L \Phi L')\) uniquenesses \(\psi = 1 - h^2\). Flag: Heywood (\(\psi < -\)heywood\_tol impossible loadings), near-Heywood (\(\psi\) within [-near\_heywood, near\_heywood]), salient loading (\(|loading| <\) loading), cross-loadings (2+ salient loadings; severity scored gap two largest absolute loadings). Enforce min_items_per_factor using primary (largest absolute) loading; rows salient loading count toward factor. Removal policy (priority order): Remove severe Heywood item. Else remove worst near-Heywood item. Else, RMSEA exceeds thresholds$rmsea, simulate single-item removals (preserve min\_items\_per\_factor) drop candidate yielding best RMSEA improvement. Else remove structurally worst item (diagnostic score). Stop RMSEA \(\le\) threshold factors meet min\_items\_per\_factor, admissible removal improves fit/structure, maximum number steps reached. LLM justifications (optional). use_ai_analysis = TRUE item_definitions provided, function can call LLM via httr draft plain-language justifications. language (ai_config$language) verbosity (ai_config$analysis_detail) control style length. request includes, available, item-level technical statistics (primary loading, \(h^2\), reason removal, RMSEA removal step). Transient server errors (e.g., HTTP 502/503/504) rate limits (HTTP 429) handled three attempts exponential backoff. analysis purely descriptive influence optimization path. Dependencies. LLM used, httr jsonlite required; function attempts install missing.

text: function prints following sections console: Available components: names elements res. Modification log: data frame res\$log removal step. Final model: CFA model syntax stored res\$final_model. Removed items: list items removed refinement. Final fit measures: res\$final_rmsea res\$final_cfi. Reliability: composite reliability estimates computed     semTools::compRelSEM(res$final_fit, tau.eq = FALSE, ord.scale = TRUE),     indicating internal consistency factor ordinal measurement model.
